name: Bandit Gang

generalAbilities.name: Lie in Wait
generalAbilities.description: The troop can spend 10 minutes preparing the ground before combat to gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative roll.

generalAbilities.name: Sudden Ambush
generalAbilities.description: When the troop rolls initiative using Deception or Stealth, they can use Stand and Deliver! as a free action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Chop 'em Down!
offensiveAbilities.description:
to

Frequency once per round

Effect The bandits make a coordinated attack with their axes against each enemy in a 5 foot emanation with a DC 22 basic Reflex save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1d6+3 slashing damage

2d6+9 slashing damage

3d6+9 slashing damage

offensiveAbilities.name: Forest Passage
offensiveAbilities.description: The bandit gang ignores any difficult terrain caused by plants, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth.

offensiveAbilities.name: Launch Slings!
offensiveAbilities.description: The bandits draw or reload their slings, then launch a volley of sling bullets. This is a 10 foot burst within 50 feet that deals 2d6+4 bludgeoning damage with a DC 22 basic Reflex save. When the troop is reduced to 2 or fewer segments, this area decreases to a 5 foot burst.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stand and Deliver!
offensiveAbilities.description: The troop attempts to Demoralize up to 4 creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Troop Movement
offensiveAbilities.description: Whenever a troop moves, you move one of its segments and the other segments follow behind it. At the end of the movement, you can group the other segments adjacent to the one you moved as you see fit, provided none of them moves farther than the moving segment. If you choose not to move the troop any distance, you can instead reshape the position of all the segments as long as one stays in place.

description:
Cutthroat crews of criminals form gangs to take out larger scores and intimidate their victims. Bandit gangs are often accompanied by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-npc-core.Actor.Gang Leader].

In the underbelly of society, the lawless reign supreme.
